title: Resistance Training Prescription for Muscle Function, Hypertrophy, and Physical Performance in Healthy Adults: An Overview of Reviews
publisher: ACSM / Medicine & Science in Sports & Exercise
scope: Healthy adults; class-level training prescription, not device certification.
overlap: Includes prior reviews; not statistically independent of currier-2023 or failure-2022.

title: World Health Organization 2020 guidelines on physical activity and sedentary behaviour
publisher: WHO / British Journal of Sports Medicine
scope: Children, adults, older adults, pregnancy/postpartum, chronic conditions and disability.
access: official guideline summary / indexed journal text

title: Adult Activity: An Overview
scope: Adults; public-health activity targets, not a personalized fat-loss dose.
overlap: Similar public-health evidence base to WHO.

title: Physical activity guidelines for adults aged 19 to 64
scope: Adult activity and talk-test explanation.

title: Resistance training prescription for muscle strength and hypertrophy in healthy adults: a systematic review and Bayesian network meta-analysis
scope: Healthy adults; different resistance-training prescriptions.
overlap: Potentially included in acsm-2026; two documents do not imply two independent datasets.

title: Effect of free-weight vs. machine-based strength training on maximal strength, hypertrophy and jump performance – a systematic review and meta-analysis
publisher: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation
scope: Adults; relatively few hypertrophy trials. No significant difference does not prove equivalence.

title: Effects of resistance training performed to repetition failure or non-failure on muscular strength and hypertrophy: A systematic review and meta-analysis
publisher: Journal of Sport and Health Science
scope: Resistance training to failure vs non-failure. Online publication 2021; journal issue 2022.

title: A systematic review, meta-analysis and meta-regression of the effect of protein supplementation on resistance training-induced gains in muscle mass and strength in healthy adults
scope: Healthy adults doing resistance training; average dose-response, not a universal cutoff.

title: International Society of Sports Nutrition Position Stand: protein and exercise
publisher: Journal of the International Society of Sports Nutrition
scope: Exercising adults; consult conflicts-of-interest disclosures. Not a renal-disease prescription.

title: Aerobic Exercise and Weight Loss in Adults: A Systematic Review and Dose-Response Meta-Analysis
scope: Adults with overweight or obesity; average supervised-trial effects, not promised individual loss.

title: Resistance training effectiveness on body composition and body weight outcomes in individuals with overweight and obesity across the lifespan: A systematic review and meta-analysis
scope: Overweight/obesity; separates fat mass, lean mass and total weight.

title: Recommended Amount of Sleep for a Healthy Adult: A Joint Consensus Statement of the American Academy of Sleep Medicine and Sleep Research Society
scope: Healthy adults; regular sleep duration, not a recovery score.

title: Sleep and the athlete: narrative review and 2021 expert consensus recommendations
scope: Athletes; individualize requirements. Not a validated rule for every recreational trainee.

title: A Meta-Analysis of the Effects of Foam Rolling on Performance and Recovery
scope: Short-term flexibility, soreness and performance; effects often small.

title: Stretching to prevent or reduce muscle soreness after exercise
scope: Stretching and delayed-onset muscle soreness; not all flexibility goals.

title: Physical Activity and Exercise During Pregnancy and the Postpartum Period: ACOG Committee Opinion, Number 804
scope: Uncomplicated pregnancy/postpartum with individual obstetric assessment.

title: Exercise/Physical Activity in Individuals with Type 2 Diabetes: A Consensus Statement from the American College of Sports Medicine
scope: Type 2 diabetes; medication, hypoglycemia and complications change prescription.

title: WHO releases guidelines on chronic low back pain
scope: Chronic primary low back pain; not undiagnosed trauma or emergency neurological symptoms.

title: Back pain
scope: Self-care boundaries and urgent neurological/systemic warning signs.

title: Sprains and strains
scope: Acute soft-tissue injury care and reasons to seek assessment.

title: 2019 American College of Rheumatology/Arthritis Foundation Guideline for the Management of Osteoarthritis of the Hand, Hip, and Knee
scope: Diagnosed hand, hip and knee osteoarthritis; symptoms and preferences matter.

title: Accuracy of Smart Scales on Weight and Body Composition: Observational Study
scope: Specific consumer scales tested; cannot generalize exact error to every device.

title: Selectorized Strength Training Machines
scope: Equipment category and configuration only; commercial material, not efficacy evidence.

title: Selectorized strength machines
scope: Corroborates machine category names; no independent medical efficacy claim.

title: What Damper Setting and Drag Factor to Use on the Concept2 RowErg, SkiErg and BikeErg
scope: Concept2 air-resistance equipment: damper setting is not intensity. Not all rower types.

title: Compatibility of Concurrent Aerobic and Strength Training for Skeletal Muscle Size and Function: An Updated Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
scope: Concurrent training; explosive strength can differ from hypertrophy outcomes.

title: Longer Interset Rest Periods Enhance Muscle Strength and Hypertrophy in Resistance-Trained Men
publisher: Journal of Strength and Conditioning Research
scope: Small trial in resistance-trained men; not a universal rest-duration threshold.

title: About Body Mass Index (BMI)
scope: BMI is a screening measure, not a direct body-fat measurement.

title: Tips to help you lose weight
scope: Adult weight-management habits; not for pregnancy, children or eating disorders.

title: Resistance training-induced changes in integrated myofibrillar protein synthesis are related to hypertrophy only after attenuation of muscle damage
scope: Ten young men over training; mechanistic muscle-damage/protein-synthesis observations, not a diagnostic test for soreness.
overlap: Small study; do not equate microscopic damage with every subjective pain report.

title: Blood Flow Restriction Exercise: Considerations of Methodology, Application, and Safety
scope: BFR methodology and safety; professional assessment, not a DIY cuff-pressure recipe.
access: publisher text and 2019 correction: application overview, safety context and corrected competing-interest statement
overlap: Correction 10.3389/fphys.2019.01332 checked: an author affiliation with a commercial BFR education company was disclosed and the wording "Position Stand" was removed; authors stated scientific conclusions were unchanged. Treated here as an expert review, not a society position stand. No DIY cuff-pressure prescription.

title: Chest pain
scope: Chest-pain red flags and when to seek emergency help; UK emergency numbers must be localized.
overlap: Same organization as NHS back/sprain guidance; not an independent clinical trial.

title: Hammer Strength Plate-Loaded Iso-Lateral Front Lat Pulldown
scope: Plate-loaded arms, adjustable seat and thigh pads. Structure only; no independent efficacy or safety validation.
reviewStatus: desk-reviewed structure; independent expert and model-specific review pending
overlap: Commercial manufacturer information. Not a clinical study; marketing efficacy claims are not adopted.

title: Hammer Strength Seated Arm Curl
scope: Preacher-curl support bench; separate free weights provide resistance. Structure only; no independent efficacy or safety validation.
reviewStatus: desk-reviewed structure; independent expert and model-specific review pending
overlap: Commercial manufacturer information. Not a clinical study; marketing efficacy claims are not adopted.

title: Life Fitness Dip/Leg Raise
scope: Elbow-supported leg-raise station; some models also support dips. Structure only; no independent efficacy or safety validation.
reviewStatus: desk-reviewed structure; independent expert and model-specific review pending
overlap: Commercial manufacturer information. Not a clinical study; marketing efficacy claims are not adopted.

title: DOMYOS Pilates Ring
scope: Resistance ring and contact pads; not a suspension ring. Structure only; no independent efficacy or safety validation.
reviewStatus: desk-reviewed structure; independent expert and model-specific review pending
overlap: Commercial manufacturer information. Not a clinical study; marketing efficacy claims are not adopted.
